title: Projektetage Figure Cover Fit
description: Fix figure disposition distortions on projektetage slide 8 (Bauteilkatalog) and elsewhere. Per presentation AGENTS.md: embodiments MUST NOT distort; always filled, scaled to shorter-side, centered, cover arbitrary target size. Root cause: figureCropBackgroundVars uses stretch-fill at rest instead of uniform cover.
summary:
Fixed distorted figure dispositions on projektetage Bauteilkatalog (slide 8) and all crop tiles.

Root cause: `figureCropBackgroundVars` used stretch-fill at rest (different background-size X/Y), violating presentation spec: embodiments must cover the frame with uniform shorter-side scale and centering.

Fix: Apply the same cover scale and center position to rest CSS vars as morph vars; fallback without frame uses max(stretchWidth, stretchHeight). Non-crop figures use `object-fit: cover` always (was `contain` at rest).

68 renderer tests pass.
